<!-- This is a local template. It creates no hosted workflow or remote issue by itself. -->

## Identity

- Local ticket ID:
- Owner role (A01–A09):
- Priority (P0/P1/P2):
- Milestone:
- Status:
- Requirement IDs:
- Dependencies / blocker owner:

## Problem and intended result

State the player or developer outcome and current behaviour. Link the corresponding entry in `docs/planning/BACKLOG.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Observable result, including boundary/failure cases.
- [ ] Required input/platform coverage and asset provenance.

## Verification

Commands and meaningful automated assertions; human playtest steps; required hardware; evidence path. State what cannot be certified in the current environment.

## Cost and scope

List dependencies/assets/services. No purchases, paid APIs, hosted compute or billing changes are authorized. Significant shared API, control, product or licensing decisions need the appropriate ADR/owner review.

## Handoff

Files changed, result, unresolved defects and the next concrete action. Do not mark Done until all acceptance evidence is present.
